explanation: King of Judah who prayed to God for healing and protection against the Assyrians.
An illness or condition that negatively affects the body, in this case Hezekiah's fatal disease.
A person who receives and delivers messages from God, in this case Isaiah.
The prophet who brought God's message and promise of healing to Hezekiah.
The process of becoming well or restoring health; here it refers to Hezekiah's recovery.
An event or action that confirms a divine message, in this case the shadow moving backward on the steps.
An ancient empire and people who threatened Judah but were defeated by God after Hezekiah's prayer.
Communication with God where one asks for help, guidance, or gives thanks for blessings.
